events.title: Mary Lou Jepsen leads OLPC display engineering
events.summary: Mary Lou Jepsen engineered the low-power display for One Laptop per Child (2007) — cutting cost and power for education laptops.
events.about: OLPC's $100 laptop mission pushed developers to target constrained hardware. Jepsen's display work made sunlight-readable, low-watt screens viable for mass education deployments.

narrative.whyChosen: OLPC displays proved affordable laptops could reach developing-world classrooms.
narrative.whyImportant: Hardware cost barriers shape which populations learn to program.
narrative.problemSolved: Laptop displays consumed too much power and cost for education markets.
